This is a continuation of my Analaysis_1.1.RMD that worked up to running all my chapter 1 code with different test and calibration datasets.  This .RMD is for the parallelized version for repeat internal 10-fold CV on a single dataset.  


```{r}

# =============================================================================
#
# FT-NIRS MODELING FRAMEWORK - REPEATED 10-FOLD CV SCRIPT
#
# This script runs the full 5-model analysis (PCA, PLS, XGB, RF, Simple)
# using a repeated 10-fold cross-validation structure, executed in parallel.
#
# =============================================================================

# --- 1. Load Required Libraries ---
# Make sure all are loaded in your session
# library(pacman)
# p_load(mdatools, prospectr, tidyverse, stringr, purrr, viridis,
#        mgcv, MuMIn, caret, ranger, xgboost, dplyr, future, furrr, cli)

# =-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# --- 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS (Copied from full_modeling_framework.R) ---
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------



# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Data processing
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Evenly split dataframe based on read_age
generate_multiple_splits <- function(data, n_splits,
                                     strata_col = "read_age",
                                     group_col = "region") {
  
  # Get unique regions
  regions <- unique(data[[group_col]])
  
  # Generate n_splits sets of folds
  purrr::map(1:n_splits, function(split_num) {
    
    # For each region, create folds stratified by age
    region_folds <- purrr::map(regions, function(reg) {
      region_data <- data[data[[group_col]] == reg, ]
      region_indices <- which(data[[group_col]] == reg)
      
      # Create folds using the indices within this region
      folds <- caret::createFolds(
        region_data[[strata_col]],
        k = 10,
        list = TRUE,
        returnTrain = FALSE
      )
      
      # Convert local indices to global indices
      purrr::map(folds, ~ region_indices[.x])
    })
    
    # Combine folds across regions
    # Fold 1 = Kodiak fold 1 + Shumagin fold 1 + LPW fold 1, etc.
    combined_folds <- purrr::map(1:10, function(fold_num) {
      unlist(purrr::map(region_folds, fold_num))
    })
    
    names(combined_folds) <- paste0("Fold", sprintf("%02d", 1:10))
    combined_folds
  })
}

generate_multiple_splits <- function(data, n_splits) {
  purrr::map(1:n_splits, ~caret::createFolds(data[["read_age"]], k = 10, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE))
}

# get FT-NIRS wavenumber columns by search for only numerical column names
find_cols <- function(df){
  names(df)[grepl("^\\d", names(df))]
}

# take FT-NIRS dataframe, make it long for plotting
make_long <- function(df) {
  speccols <- find_cols(df)
  df_long <- df %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = speccols) %>%
    # rename(wavenumber = name) %>%
    # mutate(wavenumber = as.numeric(as.character(wavenumber)))
    mutate(name = as.numeric(as.character(name)))
  return(df_long)
}


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# FT-NIRS preprocessing functions: Savitzky-Golay & SNV
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# apply SG filtering to dataframe
sg_filter <- function(df, m, p, w) {
  speccols <- find_cols(df)
  metacols <- setdiff(names(df), speccols)
  sg_matrix <- savitzkyGolay(df[, speccols], m = m, p = p, w = w)
  new_speccols <- find_cols(sg_matrix)
  names(sg_matrix) <- new_speccols
  return(dplyr::bind_cols(df[, metacols], as.data.frame(sg_matrix)))
}

# apply SNV to dataframe
snv_filter <- function(df){
  speccols <- find_cols(df)
  metacols <- setdiff(names(df), speccols)
  snv_matrix <- prep.snv(as.matrix(df[,speccols]))
  return(dplyr::bind_cols(df[, metacols], as.data.frame(snv_matrix)))
}

wave_filter <- function(df, wave){
  speccols <- find_cols(df)
  metacols <- setdiff(names(df), speccols)
  keep_me <- as.numeric(speccols) <= wave
  speccols_keep <- speccols[keep_me]
  return(df[, c(metacols, speccols_keep)])
}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Model Performance
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# get RPD from model
calculate_rpd <- function(observed, predicted) { sd(observed) / sqrt(mean((observed - predicted)^2)) }
# get bias from model
calculate_bias <- function(observed, predicted) { mean(predicted - observed) }

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
# Plotting
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------- #
spec.fig <- function(df, color) {
  mydf <- make_long(df)
  # 1. Quoting to allow column name use later
  color_col <- rlang::enquo(color) 

  # 2. Sort the data by the grouping variable (specimen) and the x-axis (name)
  mydf_sorted <- mydf %>% 
    dplyr::arrange(specimen, name) 
  
  # 3. Plot the sorted data
  ggplot(mydf_sorted) +
    geom_path(aes(x = name, y = value, color = !!color_col, group = specimen)) +
    scale_x_reverse() +
    scale_color_viridis() +
    labs(y = "Absorbance", x = expression(paste("Wavenumber ", cm^-1))) + 
    theme_bw(base_size = 16)
}

# --- B. Find Spectral Columns ---
find_cols <- function(df) {
  names(df)[grepl("^\\d", names(df))]
}

# --- C. PCA Importance Helpers ---
get_pc_indices_lm <- function(term) {
  as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(attr(term, "term.labels"), "\\d+"))
}
get_pc_indices_gam <- function(formula) {
  pc_matches <- stringr::str_extract_all(as.character(formula)[3], "PC\\d+")[[1]]
  as.numeric(stringr::str_extract(pc_matches, "\\d+"))
}
calculate_pca_vector_length <- function(pca_rotation, pc_indices) {
  if (length(pc_indices) == 0 || is.null(pc_indices)) {
    return(rep(0, nrow(pca_rotation)))
  }
  valid_indices <- pc_indices[!is.na(pc_indices)]
  if (length(valid_indices) == 0) {
    return(rep(0, nrow(pca_rotation)))
  }
  loadings_subset <- pca_rotation[, valid_indices, drop = FALSE]
  sqrt(rowSums(loadings_subset^2))
}

# --- D. Data Splitting Function ---
generate_multiple_splits <- function(data, n_splits) {
  purrr::map(1:n_splits, ~ caret::createFolds(data[["read_age"]], k = 10, list = TRUE, returnTrain = FALSE))
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# --- 3. INDIVIDUAL MODEL RUNNER FUNCTIONS (SILENT) ---
# =============================================================================
# These are the same functions from your simple framework, but with
# all `cli::` print messages removed so they don't flood the parallel log.

# --- A. PCA-LM and PCA-GAM Runner ---
run_pca_models_silent <- function(cal_df, test_df, terms_lm, terms_gam) {
  spec_cols <- find_cols(cal_df)
  
  pc.mod <- caret::preProcess(cal_df[, spec_cols],
    method = c("center", "pca"),
    pcaComp = 10
  )
  
  cal_pca <- cbind(predict(pc.mod, cal_df[, spec_cols]), cal_df)
  test_pca <- cbind(predict(pc.mod, test_df[, spec_cols]), test_df)
  
  metrics_lm_list <- list()
  preds_lm_list <- list()
  importance_lm_list <- list()
  
  for (j in 1:10) {
    mod_name <- paste("PCA-LM", j)
    mod <- lm(data = cal_pca, terms_lm[[j]])
    preds <- predict(mod, newdata = test_pca)
    
    metrics_lm_list[[j]] <- data.frame(
      model_type = "PCA-LM",
      model_name = mod_name,
      R2 = cor(preds, test_pca$read_age)^2,
      RMSE = caret::RMSE(pred = preds, obs = test_pca$read_age),
      RPD = calculate_rpd(test_pca$read_age, preds),
      Bias = calculate_bias(test_pca$read_age, preds)
    )
    preds_lm_list[[j]] <- data.frame(
      specimen = test_pca$specimen,
      obs_age = test_pca$read_age,
      pred_age = preds,
      model_type = "PCA-LM",
      model_name = mod_name
    )
    pc_indices <- get_pc_indices_lm(terms_lm[[j]])
    importance_lm_list[[j]] <- data.frame(
      model_type = "PCA-LM",
      model_name = mod_name,
      wavenumber = as.numeric(rownames(pc.mod$rotation)),
      importance = calculate_pca_vector_length(pc.mod$rotation, pc_indices)
    )
  }
  
  metrics_gam_list <- list()
  preds_gam_list <- list()
  importance_gam_list <- list()
  
  for (j in 1:10) {
    mod_name <- paste("PCA-GAM", j)
    mod <- gam(data = cal_pca, terms_gam[[j]], method = "REML")
    preds <- predict(mod, newdata = test_pca)
    
    metrics_gam_list[[j]] <- data.frame(
      model_type = "PCA-GAM",
      model_name = mod_name,
      R2 = cor(preds, test_pca$read_age)^2,
      RMSE = caret::RMSE(pred = preds, obs = test_pca$read_age),
      RPD = calculate_rpd(test_pca$read_age, preds),
      Bias = calculate_bias(test_pca$read_age, preds)
    )
    preds_gam_list[[j]] <- data.frame(
      specimen = test_pca$specimen,
      obs_age = test_pca$read_age,
      pred_age = preds,
      model_type = "PCA-GAM",
      model_name = mod_name
    )
    pc_indices <- get_pc_indices_gam(terms_gam[[j]])
    importance_gam_list[[j]] <- data.frame(
      model_type = "PCA-GAM",
      model_name = mod_name,
      wavenumber = as.numeric(rownames(pc.mod$rotation)),
      importance = calculate_pca_vector_length(pc.mod$rotation, pc_indices)
    )
  }
  
  return(list(
    metrics = bind_rows(metrics_lm_list, metrics_gam_list),
    predictions = bind_rows(preds_lm_list, preds_gam_list),
    importance = bind_rows(importance_lm_list, importance_gam_list)
  ))
}

# --- B. PLS and PLS-VIP Runner ---
run_pls_models_silent <- function(cal_df, test_df, vip_threshold = 1.0) {
  spec_cols <- find_cols(cal_df)
  
  Xc <- as.matrix(cal_df[, spec_cols])
  Yc <- as.matrix(cal_df$read_age)
  Xt <- as.matrix(test_df[, spec_cols])
  Yt <- as.matrix(test_df$read_age)
  
  mod_pls <- mdatools::pls(Xc, Yc,
    cv = 1, scale = FALSE, center = TRUE,
    x.test = Xt, y.test = Yt
  )
  ncomp_pls <- mod_pls$ncomp.selected
  vip_scores <- mdatools::vipscores(mod_pls, ncomp = ncomp_pls)
  excl_cols_vip <- which(vip_scores < vip_threshold)
  
  mod_vip <- mdatools::pls(Xc, Yc,
    cv = 1, scale = FALSE, center = TRUE,
    x.test = Xt, y.test = Yt,
    exclcols = excl_cols_vip
  )
  ncomp_vip <- mod_vip$ncomp.selected
  
  metrics <- bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      model_type = "PLS", model_name = "PLS",
      R2 = mod_pls$testres$r2[ncomp_pls], RMSE = mod_pls$testres$rmse[ncomp_pls],
      RPD = mod_pls$testres$rpd[ncomp_pls], Bias = mod_pls$testres$bias[ncomp_pls]
    ),
    data.frame(
      model_type = "PLS-VIP", model_name = paste0("PLS-VIP (>", vip_threshold, ")"),
      R2 = mod_vip$testres$r2[ncomp_vip], RMSE = mod_vip$testres$rmse[ncomp_vip],
      RPD = mod_vip$testres$rpd[ncomp_vip], Bias = mod_vip$testres$bias[ncomp_vip]
    )
  )
  
  predictions <- bind_rows(
    data.frame(
      specimen = test_df$specimen, obs_age = Yt,
      pred_age = mod_pls$testres$y.pred[, ncomp_pls, 1],
      model_type = "PLS", model_name = "PLS"
    ),
    data.frame(
      specimen = test_df$specimen, obs_age = Yt,
      pred_age = mod_vip$testres$y.pred[, ncomp_vip, 1],
      model_type = "PLS-VIP", model_name = paste0("PLS-VIP (>", vip_threshold, ")")
    )
  )
  
  importance <- data.frame(
    model_type = "PLS-VIP", model_name = "PLS-VIP",
    wavenumber = as.numeric(colnames(Xc)),
    importance = as.vector(vip_scores)
  )
  
  return(list(metrics = metrics, predictions = predictions, importance = importance))
}

# --- C. XGBoost Runner ---
run_xgb_model_silent <- function(cal_df, test_df, best_params_xgb) {
  spec_cols <- find_cols(cal_df)
  
  dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(cal_df[, spec_cols]), label = cal_df$read_age)
  dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(test_df[, spec_cols]), label = test_df$read_age)
  
  params <- list(
    objective = "reg:squarederror", booster = "gbtree", nthread = 1,
    eta = best_params_xgb$eta, max_depth = best_params_xgb$max_depth,
    min_child_weight = best_params_xgb$min_child_weight, subsample = best_params_xgb$subsample,
    gamma = best_params_xgb$gamma, colsample_bytree = best_params_xgb$colsample_bytree
  )
  best_nrounds <- round(best_params_xgb$mean_nrounds)
  
  mod_xgb <- xgb.train(
    params = params, data = dtrain,
    nrounds = best_nrounds, verbose = 0
  )
  
  preds <- predict(mod_xgb, dtest)
  obs <- test_df$read_age
  
  metrics <- data.frame(
    model_type = "XGB", model_name = "XGBoost",
    R2 = cor(preds, obs)^2, RMSE = caret::RMSE(pred = preds, obs = obs),
    RPD = calculate_rpd(obs, preds), Bias = calculate_bias(obs, preds)
  )
  
  predictions <- data.frame(
    specimen = test_df$specimen, obs_age = obs, pred_age = preds,
    model_type = "XGB", model_name = "XGBoost"
  )
  
  imp_matrix <- xgb.importance(model = mod_xgb)
  imp_df <- data.frame(Feature = colnames(cal_df[, spec_cols])) %>%
    left_join(imp_matrix, by = "Feature") %>%
    mutate(
      model_type = "XGB", model_name = "XGBoost",
      wavenumber = as.numeric(Feature),
      importance = ifelse(is.na(Gain), 0, Gain)
    ) %>%
    select(model_type, model_name, wavenumber, importance)
  
  return(list(metrics = metrics, predictions = predictions, importance = imp_df))
}

# --- D. Random Forest Runner ---
run_rf_model_silent <- function(cal_df, test_df, best_params_rf) {
  spec_cols <- find_cols(cal_df)
  
  mod_rf <- ranger(
    x = cal_df[, spec_cols], y = cal_df$read_age,
    mtry = best_params_rf$mtry, min.node.size = best_params_rf$min.node.size,
    splitrule = "variance", importance = 'permutation',
    num.trees = 1000, num.threads = 1
  )
  
  preds <- predict(mod_rf, data = test_df)$predictions
  obs <- test_df$read_age
  
  metrics <- data.frame(
    model_type = "RF", model_name = "Random Forest",
    R2 = cor(preds, obs)^2, RMSE = caret::RMSE(pred = preds, obs = obs),
    RPD = calculate_rpd(obs, preds), Bias = calculate_bias(obs, preds)
  )
  
  predictions <- data.frame(
    specimen = test_df$specimen, obs_age = obs, pred_age = preds,
    model_type = "RF", model_name = "Random Forest"
  )
  
  importance <- data.frame(
    model_type = "RF", model_name = "Random Forest",
    wavenumber = as.numeric(names(mod_rf$variable.importance)),
    importance = as.vector(mod_rf$variable.importance)
  )
  
  return(list(metrics = metrics, predictions = predictions, importance = importance))
}

# --- E. Simple Models (Bio-only) Runner ---
run_simple_models_silent <- function(cal_df, test_df) {
  bio_vars <- c("read_age", "length", "structure_weight")
  
  cal_simple <- cal_df[complete.cases(cal_df[, bio_vars]), ]
  test_simple <- test_df[complete.cases(test_df[, bio_vars]), ]
  
  if (nrow(cal_simple) == 0 || nrow(test_simple) == 0) {
    return(NULL) # Return NULL if no data
  }
  
  # --- Model 1: Simple LM ---
  mod_lm <- lm(read_age ~ length + structure_weight, data = cal_simple)
  preds_lm <- predict(mod_lm, newdata = test_simple)
  obs <- test_simple$read_age
  
  metrics_lm <- data.frame(
    model_type = "Simple", model_name = "Simple-LM (L+SW)",
    R2 = cor(preds_lm, obs)^2, RMSE = caret::RMSE(pred = preds_lm, obs = obs),
    RPD = calculate_rpd(obs, preds_lm), Bias = calculate_bias(obs, preds_lm)
  )
  preds_lm_df <- data.frame(
    specimen = test_simple$specimen, obs_age = obs, pred_age = preds_lm,
    model_type = "Simple", model_name = "Simple-LM (L+SW)"
  )
  
  # --- Model 2: Simple GAM ---
  mod_gam <- mgcv::gam(read_age ~ s(length, k = 4) + s(structure_weight, k = 4),
    data = cal_simple, method = "REML"
  )
  preds_gam <- predict(mod_gam, newdata = test_simple)
  
  metrics_gam <- data.frame(
    model_type = "Simple", model_name = "Simple-GAM (L+SW)",
    R2 = cor(preds_gam, obs)^2, RMSE = caret::RMSE(pred = preds_gam, obs = obs),
    RPD = calculate_rpd(obs, preds_gam), Bias = calculate_bias(obs, preds_gam)
  )
  preds_gam_df <- data.frame(
    specimen = test_simple$specimen, obs_age = obs, pred_age = preds_gam,
    model_type = "Simple", model_name = "Simple-GAM (L+SW)"
  )
  
  return(list(
    metrics = bind_rows(metrics_lm, metrics_gam),
    predictions = bind_rows(preds_lm_df, preds_gam_df),
    importance = data.frame()
  ))
}
```

```{r}

# =============================================================================
# --- 4. THE PARALLEL CV WORKER FUNCTION ---
# =============================================================================
# This is the new "worker" function that runs *everything* for a single fold.
# It will be called 100 times in parallel (for 10 rounds x 10 folds).

run_all_models_for_fold <- function(cal_indices, test_indices,
                                    full_df,
                                    terms_lm, terms_gam,
                                    best_params_xgb, best_params_rf,
                                    vip_threshold = 1.0) {
  
  # --- 1. Subset data for this fold ---
  cal_df <- full_df[cal_indices, ]
  test_df <- full_df[test_indices, ]
  
  # --- 2. Initialize containers ---
  metrics_list <- list()
  predictions_list <- list()
  importance_list <- list()
  
  # --- 3. Run all model types (silently) ---
  
  tryCatch({
    pca_results <- run_pca_models_silent(cal_df, test_df, terms_lm, terms_gam)
    metrics_list$pca <- pca_results$metrics
    predictions_list$pca <- pca_results$predictions
    importance_list$pca <- pca_results$importance
  }, error = function(e) { message("PCA Models FAILED for a fold: ", e$message) })
  
  tryCatch({
    pls_results <- run_pls_models_silent(cal_df, test_df, vip_threshold)
    metrics_list$pls <- pls_results$metrics
    predictions_list$pls <- pls_results$predictions
    importance_list$pls <- pls_results$importance
  }, error = function(e) { message("PLS Models FAILED for a fold: ", e$message) })
  
  tryCatch({
    xgb_results <- run_xgb_model_silent(cal_df, test_df, best_params_xgb)
    metrics_list$xgb <- xgb_results$metrics
    predictions_list$xgb <- xgb_results$predictions
    importance_list$xgb <- xgb_results$importance
  }, error = function(e) { message("XGBoost Model FAILED for a fold: ", e$message) })
  
  tryCatch({
    rf_results <- run_rf_model_silent(cal_df, test_df, best_params_rf)
    metrics_list$rf <- rf_results$metrics
    predictions_list$rf <- rf_results$predictions
    importance_list$rf <- rf_results$importance
  }, error = function(e) { message("Random Forest Model FAILED for a fold: ", e$message) })
  
  tryCatch({
    simple_results <- run_simple_models_silent(cal_df, test_df)
    if (!is.null(simple_results)) {
      metrics_list$simple <- simple_results$metrics
      predictions_list$simple <- simple_results$predictions
    }
  }, error = function(e) { message("Simple Models FAILED for a fold: ", e$message) })
  
  # --- 4. Combine and return all results for this fold ---
  all_metrics <- bind_rows(metrics_list)
  all_predictions <- bind_rows(predictions_list)
  all_importance <- bind_rows(importance_list)
  
  return(list(
    metrics = all_metrics,
    predictions = all_predictions,
    importance = all_importance
  ))
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# --- 5. MAIN PARALLEL CV WRAPPER FUNCTION ---

#' Run All Models with Repeated 10-Fold CV
#'
#' Runs the full 5-model analysis in a parallel repeated 10-fold CV framework.
#'
#' @param df The *single* dataframe to perform the CV on.
#' @param num_rounds Number of times to repeat the 10-fold CV.
#' @param best_params_xgb A 1-row data frame with tuned XGBoost params.
#' @param best_params_rf A 1-row data frame with tuned Random Forest params.
#' @param vip_threshold The VIP score threshold for the PLS-VIP model.
#' @param n_cores Number of cores to use for parallel processing.
#'
#' @return A list containing three aggregated data frames:
#'         $all_cv_metrics, $all_cv_predictions, $all_cv_importance
#'
#'
run_all_models_cv <- function(df, num_rounds, terms_lm, terms_gam,
                              best_params_xgb, best_params_rf,
                              vip_threshold = 1.0, n_cores = 8) {
  
  cli::cli_h1(paste("Starting Repeated CV for", deparse(substitute(df))))
  
  # # --- 1. Pre-computation: Dredge (Done once on the full dataset) ---

  # dredge_global_lm <- lm(read_age ~ ., data = dredge_model_data, na.action = "na.fail", model = TRUE)

  #   data = dredge_model_data,
  #   read_age ~ s(PC1, k = 4) + s(PC2, k = 4) + s(PC3, k = 4) + s(PC4, k = 4) + s(PC5, k = 4) +
  #     s(PC6, k = 4) + s(PC7, k = 4) + s(PC8, k = 4) + s(PC9, k = 4) + s(PC10, k = 4),
  #   na.action = "na.fail",
  #   model = TRUE
  # )
  # 
  # suppressMessages({
  #   top10_lm_models <- get.models(dredge(dredge_global_lm, trace = FALSE), subset = 1:10)
  #   top10_gam_models <- get.models(dredge(dredge_global_gam, trace = FALSE), subset = 1:10)
  # })
  # 
  # terms_lm <- lapply(top10_lm_models, function(m) m$terms)
  # terms_gam <- lapply(top10_gam_models, function(m) m$formula)
  # 
  # cli::cli_alert_success("Dredge pre-computation complete.")
  
  # --- 2. Create Job Manifest ---
  cli::cli_alert_info(paste("Generating", num_rounds * 10, "CV fold jobs..."))
  
  test.idx_nested <- generate_multiple_splits(df, num_rounds)
  cal.idx_nested <- purrr::map(test.idx_nested, ~ {
    purrr::map(., ~ setdiff(1:nrow(df), .))
  })
  
  all_cal_idx <- purrr::flatten(cal.idx_nested)
  all_test_idx <- purrr::flatten(test.idx_nested)
  
  job_ids <- tidyr::expand_grid(round = 1:num_rounds, fold = 1:10)
  
  # --- 3. Run All Folds in Parallel ---
  cli::cli_alert_info(paste("Running CV on", n_cores, "cores... (this will take a while)"))
  
  plan(multisession, workers = n_cores)
  
  # Use future_map2 to run all 100 (or N) jobs.
  # This returns a list where each element is the output of `run_all_models_for_fold`
  all_fold_results_list <- furrr::future_map2(
    .x = all_cal_idx,
    .y = all_test_idx,
    ~ run_all_models_for_fold(
      cal_indices = .x,
      test_indices = .y,
      full_df = df,
      terms_lm = terms_lm,
      terms_gam = terms_gam,
      best_params_xgb = best_params_xgb,
      best_params_rf = best_params_rf,
      vip_threshold = vip_threshold
    ),
    # Set seed for reproducibility in parallel
    .options = furrr_options(seed = TRUE)
  )
  
  plan(sequential)
  cli::cli_alert_success("Parallel CV execution complete.")
  
  # --- 4. Aggregate All Results ---
  cli::cli_alert_info("Aggregating results...")
  
  # Add the 'round' and 'fold' IDs to each dataframe
  all_cv_metrics <- purrr::map_dfr(all_fold_results_list, "metrics", .id = "job_id")
  all_cv_predictions <- purrr::map_dfr(all_fold_results_list, "predictions", .id = "job_id")
  all_cv_importance <- purrr::map_dfr(all_fold_results_list, "importance", .id = "job_id")
  
  # Join with the job_ids tibble to get clean 'round' and 'fold' columns
  # We use `as.numeric(job_id)` because the .id from map_dfr is a character
  job_ids_with_id <- job_ids %>% mutate(job_id = as.character(row_number()))
  
  all_cv_metrics <- all_cv_metrics %>%
    left_join(job_ids_with_id, by = "job_id") %>%
    select(-job_id)
    
  all_cv_predictions <- all_cv_predictions %>%
    left_join(job_ids_with_id, by = "job_id") %>%
    select(-job_id)
    
  all_cv_importance <- all_cv_importance %>%
    left_join(job_ids_with_id, by = "job_id") %>%
    select(-job_id)
  
  cli::cli_alert_success("Aggregation complete.")
  
  # --- 5. Return Final List ---
  return(list(
    all_cv_metrics = all_cv_metrics,
    all_cv_predictions = all_cv_predictions,
    all_cv_importance = all_cv_importance
  ))
}
```

Functiont to run models

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# --- 6. RUN MODELS (Repeated 10-fold CV) ---
# =============================================================================

run_experiment <- function(df_to_run,
                           save_prefix,
                           num_rounds,
                           best_params_xgb,
                           best_params_rf,
                           vip_threshold = 1.0,
                           n_cores = 8) {
  
  # --- 1. Run Dredge Pre-computation ---
  cli::cli_h1(paste("Running Dredge Pre-computation for:", save_prefix))
  
  pca_spec_cols <- find_cols(df_to_run)
  dredge_pc.mod <- caret::preProcess(df_to_run[, pca_spec_cols],
    method = c("center", "pca"),
    pcaComp = 10
  )
  dredge_cal_pca <- cbind(predict(dredge_pc.mod, df_to_run[, pca_spec_cols]), df_to_run)
  
  dredge_model_data <- dredge_cal_pca[, c("read_age", paste0("PC", 1:10))]
  
  dredge_global_lm <- lm(read_age ~ ., data = dredge_model_data, na.action = "na.fail", model = TRUE)
  dredge_global_gam <- mgcv::gam(
    data = dredge_model_data,
    read_age ~ s(PC1, k = 4) + s(PC2, k = 4) + s(PC3, k = 4) + s(PC4, k = 4) + s(PC5, k = 4) +
      s(PC6, k = 4) + s(PC7, k = 4) + s(PC8, k = 4) + s(PC9, k = 4) + s(PC10, k = 4),
    na.action = "na.fail",
    model = TRUE
  )
  
  # --- START: DREDGE HACK ---
  # This is the fix. We temporarily copy the data to the global environment
  # so dredge() can find it, then we remove it immediately after.
  .GlobalEnv$dredge_model_data <- dredge_model_data
  # ---
  
  cli::cli_alert_info("Dredging LM... (this may take a moment)")
  suppressMessages({
    top10_lm_models <- get.models(dredge(dredge_global_lm, trace = FALSE), subset = 1:10)
  })
  cli::cli_alert_info("Dredging GAM... (this may take a moment)")
  suppressMessages({
    top10_gam_models <- get.models(dredge(dredge_global_gam, trace = FALSE), subset = 1:10)
  })
  
  # --- START: CLEAN UP HACK ---
  if (exists("dredge_model_data", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    rm(dredge_model_data, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  }
  # --- END HACK ---
  
  terms_lm <- lapply(top10_lm_models, function(m) m$terms)
  terms_gam <- lapply(top10_gam_models, function(m) m$formula)
  
  cli::cli_alert_success("Dredge pre-computation complete.")
  
  # --- 2. Run the main CV function ---
  set.seed(6) # For reproducible splits
  
  Sys.time()
  
  # Call the main CV runner
  cv_results <- run_all_models_cv(
    df = df_to_run,
    num_rounds = num_rounds,
    best_params_xgb = best_params_xgb,
    best_params_rf = best_params_rf,
    terms_lm = terms_lm,     # <-- Pass in dredge results
    terms_gam = terms_gam,     # <-- Pass in dredge results
    vip_threshold = vip_threshold,
    n_cores = n_cores
  )
  
  Sys.time()
  cli::cli_h1(paste("CV Analysis Complete for:", save_prefix))
  
  # --- 3. Inspect and Summarize Results ---
  cv_summary <- cv_results$all_cv_metrics %>%
    group_by(model_type, model_name) %>%
    summarize(
      mean_R2 = mean(R2),
      mean_RMSE = mean(RMSE),
      mean_RPD = mean(RPD),
      mean_Bias = mean(Bias),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(mean_RMSE)
  
  cat(paste("\n--- OVERALL CV METRICS for", save_prefix, "(Mean of", num_rounds * 10, "runs) ---\n"))
  print(cv_summary)
  
  # --- 4. Save the results with a dynamic filename ---
  save_filename <- paste0("Chapter 2/", save_prefix, "_", num_rounds, "x10_CV_results.RDS")
  saveRDS(cv_results, save_filename)
  cli::cli_alert_success(paste("Results saved to:", save_filename))
  
  # --- 5. Return the results ---
  return(cv_results)
}
```

# Plot Results
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
library(cli)

# --- 1. Load Data & Create Overall Summary ---
cli::cli_h1("Processing Data")

# Get the full (unsummarized) metrics dataframe. This has all 50 results
# (5 rounds * 10 folds) for each model. THIS IS YOUR DATA FOR BOXPLOTS.
all_cv_metrics <- all_cv_results$all_cv_metrics

# Get the data for the other plots
importance_df <- all_cv_results$all_cv_importance
predictions_df <- all_cv_results$all_cv_predictions

# Create the summary table you had, which we use to find the best models
summary_table <- all_cv_metrics %>%
  group_by(model_type, model_name) %>%
  summarize(
    RMSE = mean(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
    R2 = mean(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
    RPD = mean(RPD, na.rm = TRUE),
    Bias = mean(Bias, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# --- 2. Dynamically Find Best PCA Models ---
cli::cli_alert_info("Dynamically selecting best PCA models...")

# Find the best PCA-GAM model (lowest RMSE)
best_gam_name <- summary_table %>%
  filter(model_type == "PCA-GAM") %>%
  arrange(RMSE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  pull(model_name)

# Find the best PCA-LM model (lowest RMSE)
best_lm_name <- summary_table %>%
  filter(model_type == "PCA-LM") %>%
  arrange(RMSE) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  pull(model_name)

cat("Best PCA-GAM Model:", best_gam_name, "\n")
cat("Best PCA-LM Model:", best_lm_name, "\n")


# --- 3. Define Final Model List ---
# These are the 8 models we will show in all plots
models_to_plot <- c(
  best_gam_name,
  best_lm_name,
  "PLS",
  "PLS-VIP (>1)",
  "XGBoost",
  "Random Forest",
  "Simple-LM (L+SW)",
  "Simple-GAM (L+SW)"
)

# =============================================================================
# --- 4. PLOT 1: METRICS BOXPLOT (2x2 Grid) ---
# =============================================================================
cli::cli_h1("Generating Metrics Boxplot")

# 1. Filter the *full* metrics data to only our models of interest
metrics_for_boxplot <- all_cv_metrics %>%
  filter(model_name %in% models_to_plot)

# 2. Pivot to long format for easy plotting
metrics_long <- metrics_for_boxplot %>%
  select(model_name, R2, RMSE, RPD, Bias) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(R2, RMSE, RPD, Bias),
    names_to = "metric_name",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  # Make 'metric_name' a factor to control plot order
  mutate(
    metric_name = factor(metric_name, levels = c("RMSE", "R2", "RPD", "Bias"))
  )

# 3. Create the 2x2 plot
p_metrics_boxplot <- ggplot(metrics_long, aes(x = model_name, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  # Flip coordinates so model names are readable
  coord_flip() +
  # Create the 2x2 grid, let Y-axis be free
  facet_wrap(~metric_name, ncol = 2, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = "Model Performance (50 runs)",
    x = "Model",
    y = "Metric Value"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9) # Adjust text size for model names
  )

print(p_metrics_boxplot)

# =============================================================================
# --- 5. PLOT 2: VARIABLE IMPORTANCE (Updated) ---
# =============================================================================
cli::cli_h1("Generating Importance Plot")

models_to_plot_imp <- c(
  "PLS-VIP",
  "XGBoost",
  "Random Forest",
  best_gam_name # <-- Dynamically inserted
)

# Summarize importance (it's huge), e.g., by mean per round
importance_summary <- importance_df %>%
  group_by(model_name, wavenumber) %>%
  summarize(mean_importance = mean(importance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

importance_to_plot <- importance_summary %>%
  filter(model_name %in% models_to_plot_imp) %>%
  mutate(wavenumber = as.numeric(wavenumber)) %>%
  group_by(model_name) %>%
  mutate(importance_scaled = (mean_importance - min(mean_importance)) / (max(mean_importance) - min(mean_importance))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(model_name = factor(model_name, levels = models_to_plot_imp))

p_importance <- ggplot(importance_to_plot, aes(x = wavenumber, y = importance_scaled, color = model_name)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_reverse(name = expression(paste("Wavenumber ", cm^-1))) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Normalized Importance (0-1)") +
  facet_wrap(~model_name, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  ggtitle("Mean Model Variable Importance (across all runs)")

print(p_importance)

# =============================================================================
# --- 6. PLOT 3: PREDICTIONS (Updated) ---
# =============================================================================
cli::cli_h1("Generating Prediction Plot")

# Use the 8 models we selected earlier
models_to_plot_pred <- models_to_plot

# Use your median logic
median_ages <- predictions_df %>%
  group_by(model_name, specimen) %>%
  summarize(pred_age = median(pred_age, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

# bind matching obs_age
median_ages <- median_ages %>%
  left_join(predictions_df %>% select(specimen, obs_age) %>% distinct(), by = "specimen")

predictions_to_plot <- median_ages %>%
  filter(model_name %in% models_to_plot_pred) %>%
  mutate(model_name = factor(model_name, levels = models_to_plot_pred))

p_predictions <- ggplot(predictions_to_plot, aes(x = obs_age, y = pred_age)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~model_name, ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    x = "Observed Age (days)",
    y = "Predicted Age (days)",
    title = "Median Predicted Age vs. Observed Age (across all runs)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

print(p_predictions)
```
